1.consolidated_definition: Pala mecánica, excavadora. Máquina para excavar. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Se utilizarán varios equipos pesados, entre ellos: digger, bulldozer, track loader, así como camiones pesados y livianos (Oficina de Reglamentos y Permisos, agosto 2003)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Mechanical shovel, excavator. Machine for digging. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. Various heavy equipment will be employed, including digger, bulldozer, track loader, as well as heavy and light trucks (Office of Regulations and Permits, August 2003)
